# Rumble
> Video platform for watching, uploading, livestreaming, and monetizing creator content.

Rumble combines consumer video discovery with creator publishing, livestreaming, advertising, subscriptions, and channel management tools. Its public site includes video, channel, livestream, help, advertising, and creator-facing product pages.

## Watch & Discover
- [Home](https://rumble.com/): Main video discovery feed featuring trending, recommended, and recent content.
- [Live Streams](https://rumble.com/live): Directory of live broadcasts and currently streaming channels.
- [News](https://rumble.com/c/news): News-focused video category and publisher content hub.
- [Podcasts](https://rumble.com/podcasts): Podcast discovery area for shows published on Rumble.
- [Viral](https://rumble.com/c/viral): Viral and popular short-form and shareable video content.
- [Entertainment](https://rumble.com/c/entertainment): Entertainment category for shows, clips, and creator uploads.
- [Sports](https://rumble.com/c/sports): Sports videos, commentary, highlights, and related livestreams.

## Creators & Publishing
- [Upload](https://rumble.com/upload.php): Creator upload entry point for publishing videos to Rumble.
- [Channels](https://rumble.com/channels): Browse creator and publisher channels across the platform.
- [Rumble Studio](https://rumble.com/studio): Creator workspace for managing content, channels, and monetization tools.
- [Go Live](https://rumble.com/live/producer): Livestream production entry point for creators and broadcasters.
- [Licensing](https://rumble.com/licensing): Video licensing program for creators seeking distribution and revenue opportunities.
- [Publisher Program](https://rumble.com/publishers): Information for publishers distributing and monetizing video content.

## Monetization & Business
- [Advertising](https://rumble.com/advertising): Advertising solutions for brands reaching audiences through Rumble video inventory.
- [Subscriptions](https://rumble.com/premium): Premium subscription offering for viewers seeking an enhanced experience.
- [Rumble Cloud](https://rumble.com/cloud): Cloud infrastructure product page associated with Rumble's broader platform services.
- [Rumble Studio](https://rumble.com/studio): Creator management tools supporting publishing, revenue tracking, and channel operations.
- [Licensing](https://rumble.com/licensing): Monetization option for creators through licensing and syndication opportunities.

## Help & Support
- [Help Center](https://support.rumble.com/): Support portal for account, upload, livestream, and monetization questions.
- [Submit a Request](https://support.rumble.com/hc/en-us/requests/new): Contact form for support issues and account-related requests.
- [Help Center Home](https://support.rumble.com/hc/en-us): Main support knowledge base for Rumble users and creators.
- [Community](https://support.rumble.com/hc/en-us/community/topics): Community discussion topics and user support conversations.
- [Account Management Articles](https://support.rumble.com/hc/en-us/sections/360009905792-Account-Management): Help articles for login, profile, and account settings.
- [Channel Management Articles](https://support.rumble.com/hc/en-us/sections/360009905812-Channel-Management): Guidance for creating, editing, and managing channels.
- [Livestreaming Articles](https://support.rumble.com/hc/en-us/sections/4403451781915-Livestreaming): Help documentation for live production and streaming workflows.

## Apps & Devices
- [Our Apps](https://rumble.com/our-apps): Overview of Rumble apps and supported viewing platforms.
- [iOS App](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/rumble/id1439366983): Official Rumble app for iPhone and iPad.
- [Android App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rumble.battles): Official Rumble app for Android phones and tablets.
- [Apple TV App](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/rumble/id1439366983): App Store listing covering Apple ecosystem availability.
- [Android TV](https://rumble.com/our-apps): Device support information for Android TV viewing.
- [Roku](https://rumble.com/our-apps): Device support information for Roku streaming access.
- [Amazon Fire TV](https://rumble.com/our-apps): Device support information for Fire TV app availability.

## Company & Legal

- [Press](https://corp.rumble.com/press/): Corporate press releases and company news announcements.

- [Community Guidelines](https://rumble.com/s/community-guidelines): Rules and standards for content and user behavior on the platform.

## Developers & Integrations
- [Rumble Embed](https://rumble.com/embed/): Video embed endpoint used for integrating Rumble players on external sites.
- [Live Streams](https://rumble.com/live): Public live directory relevant to livestream distribution and discovery.
- [Rumble Cloud](https://rumble.com/cloud): Infrastructure offering that may support broader technical integrations and hosting use cases.

## Account & Access
- [Sign In](https://rumble.com/login.php): User login page for accessing accounts and creator tools.
- [Sign Up](https://rumble.com/register.php): Account registration page for new viewers and creators.
- [Premium](https://rumble.com/premium): Subscription signup and plan information for premium access.
- [Studio](https://rumble.com/studio): Authenticated creator dashboard for managing uploads and channels.
